item.title: Meta settles social media addiction lawsuit, averting trial
item.description: Two plaintiffs alleged that Meta and Snap designed their social media platforms to foster addictive behavior.

item.title: Pope Leo becomes the first pontiff to vote in a U.S. election
item.description: Pope Leo XIV became the first pontiff to vote in a U.S. election after mailing his ballot to Chicago, according to the Vatican.
